skill.summary: Feishu-integrated wrapper for the capability-evolver. Manages the evolution loop lifecycle (start/stop/ensure), sends rich Feishu card reports, and provides...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release – integrates Feishu reporting and management features for the capability-evolver.

- Adds Feishu card reporting via environment variable injection.
- Provides lifecycle management tools for starting, stopping, and monitoring the evolution loop.
- Includes dashboard generation and visualization from evolution history.
- Supports exporting evolution history to Feishu Docs.
- Replaces older crontab management with robust watchdog logic using OpenClaw Cron jobs.
